ai_summary.key_headline: Team Melli's Attacking Firepower Tested by Physical All Whites Defense

iran.philosophy: Pragmatic defensive setup with reliance on captain Mehdi Taremi's link-up quality.

new_zealand.philosophy: Direct attacking focusing on crossing and aerial dominance through Chris Wood.

tactical_insights: Iran's Mehdi Taremi will drop deep to link play and drag New Zealand's center-backs out of position.
New Zealand will prioritize set-pieces and crosses, hoping captain Chris Wood can exploit aerial duels against Iran's defense.
With Azmoun left out, the speed of Iran's wingers and Jahanbakhsh will challenge New Zealand's defensive transitions.
